title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-22
headline: Scientists name the first new wild cat species in more than a century

questions.prompt: Who formally named the new species of wild cat?
questions.hintKo: Scientists, not families or governments, formally named the cat.

questions.prompt: What is special about the tilcayo cat?
choices: It is the largest cat ever found
It is the first new living cat species named in more than a century
questions.hintKo: The story highlights that this is the first new cat species in over a century.

questions.prompt: When did the tilcayo lineage separate from the other tiger cats?
choices: About one and a half million years ago
questions.hintKo: The genetic split happened about one and a half million years ago.

questions.prompt: Where does the tilcayo cat live?
choices: In the cloud forests of Bolivia
questions.hintKo: The habitat is the cloud forest of Bolivia.

questions.prompt: Why is the species considered at risk?
choices: It is hunted for its fur
It is too large to hide
It has no natural habitat left in Bolivia
Its cloud forest habitat faces deforestation, farming, fires, and mining
questions.hintKo: The threat comes from damage to the forest habitat, not hunting or food shortage.

questions.prompt: How did researchers prove the cat is a separate species?
choices: By watching it hunt at night
By analyzing DNA from thirty-eight cats
questions.hintKo: Genetic analysis of many cat samples proved it is a distinct species.
